prompt: Create English captions for my video.mp4 suitable for YouTube.
expected: Runs local Whisper to generate an SRT or VTT file from video.mp4 with standard settings for YouTube delivery.
actual:
Executed local OpenAI Whisper against video.mp4:
Command: `whisper video.mp4 --model medium.en --output_format srt --output_dir <state_root>/captions/`
Generated `<state_root>/captions/video.srt` with standard 2-line maximum subtitle formatting ready for YouTube studio upload.

prompt: Burn stylized subtitles into tiktok.mp4 with word-level timestamps and TikTok friendly formatting.
expected: Uses whisper-timestamped to create word-level SRT/ASS, then applies ffmpeg burn-in with bold, centered styling appropriate for TikTok.
actual:
Generated word-level timed subtitles:
1. Transcribed with `whisper_timestamped`: Output word-level ASS file with TikTok visual style (Font: Montserrat Bold, Size: 22, PrimaryColour: &H00FFFFFF, OutlineColour: &H00000000, Alignment: 10/center).
2. Burned into video using FFmpeg: `ffmpeg -i tiktok.mp4 -vf "ass=<state_root>/captions/tiktok.ass" -c:a copy <state_root>/output/tiktok_subtitled.mp4`.
